description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 is oncoming relative to Vehicle 1 and goes straight through the same intersection. Vehicle 3 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns right onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 4 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1. A parked vehicle partially blocks the right edge of Vehicle 1’s lane on the exit road. A pedestrian crosses perpendicularly from the right edge to the left edge of the exit road.
